fast.description: Small, instant replies: short Q&A, transforms, batch items. Loads in seconds.

coding.description: MoE, fast for its size, strong at code and agentic tasks. Loads in tens of seconds.

browser.description: Qwen3.5-27B vision model (~17.7 GB). Sees page screenshots — for browser/GUI agents. mmproj required.

brain.description: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B MoE, Unsloth dynamic 3-bit (~46.6 GB). Hardest reasoning, long context; thinking on by default. Needs iogpu.wired_limit_mb raised (~56 GB). Loads in minutes.

heavy.description: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct dense (~47 GB), the previous brain. Short-context hard questions only; ~8-10 tok/s. Needs the raised wired limit. Loads in minutes.
